implementation: Bounded symbolic proof follows product-only helper graphs, checked shape forwarding and shared intermediates; every product must contribute to the returned matrix
One tensor task copies original input handles and ordered product edges, preflights all residence/shapes and reuses the existing strict matrix kernel and eligible tiles
Resident intermediate handles are released after last acknowledged use; cached/retained final results remain independently owned
Empty stages advance iteratively without recursive runtime handoffs; workspace is charged to the existing argument budget

cases: zero output and contraction dimensions, odd extents and repeated observations across 1/2/4 workers
shared intermediate used twice and again after another product; source re-exports/private helpers, nested chains and both-operand graph branches

allocation checkpoint sweep, cancellation/deadline/device failure at each product, destruction while externally pending
invalid empty/forward/dead/cyclic graph references and later shape/residence errors rejected before dispatch
